No Android app can run after your phone powers off or its battery reaches 0%. Callora helps you configure Call Forwarding When Unreachable (CFNRc — code 62) in advance on your mobile operator\'s network while your phone is still active.

Opening the dialer does not prove carrier activation. Callora clearly separates your saved profile from verified network status and checks SIM slot identity so rules are never silently applied to the wrong SIM.
Callora has no backend server and does not request Internet access. Your profiles, favorite numbers, and configuration history stay locally on your device.

Actionable guidance for Bangladesh SIMs, dual-SIM handsets, VoLTE, and status verification.
1. Why Forwarding Must Be Configured Before Shutdown

Once your phone shuts down or battery reaches 0%, no app can transmit commands. Activate When Unreachable (CFNRc • 62) in advance so your operator\'s network redirects calls automatically when your SIM loses signal.
2. Unsupported Operator Service or Plan Restriction

Some prepaid, corporate, or newly activated SIMs require call-divert provisioning or main account balance. On Grameenphone, minute packs and Emergency Balance do not cover diverted calls. Contact carrier care (121) if supplementary services are barred.
Verify the destination has 11 digits for Bangladesh mobiles (013–019) or full +CountryCode format, is not your own SIM number, and has incoming calls enabled.
4. Dual-SIM: Ensuring the Correct SIM Is Used
Android\'s ACTION_DIAL pre-fills the code in your system dialer, but some OEM dialers default to SIM 1. Always tap the specific Call button for your intended SIM slot.
5. Network Unavailable, VoLTE, or Wi-Fi Calling Issues
Supplementary service changes require active cellular registration or IMS UT data (VoLTE). Disable Airplane Mode, ensure mobile data/VoLTE is stable, or try via System Call Settings.
If Phone State permission was denied with \"Don\'t ask again\", open App Settings > Permissions to enable it, or continue copying codes manually into your Phone app.
7. \"Connection Problem or Invalid MMI Code\" Error

This carrier/IMS error occurs when an operator rejects an MMI code, VoLTE UT is temporarily unreachable, or a third-party dialer stripped the trailing # character. Open System Call Settings > Call forwarding instead.
Standard Android apps cannot read the result of a dialer popup. Dial *#62# (or open Phone > Settings > Call forwarding) to inspect your carrier\'s live registration directly.
When you swap SIM cards or move a SIM between Slot 1 and Slot 2, Callora pauses automatic matching and flags the SIM for review so rules never apply to the wrong line.

Carrier call forwarding stays active even after rebooting or uninstalling Callora! To turn off unexpected forwarding on a SIM, open SIM Controls and deactivate each active condition or check Phone > Settings > Call forwarding.

1. Zero Server Transmission: Callora does not declare the Android INTERNET permission and operates no backend servers, analytics SDKs, or advertising trackers. All profiles, favorite destination numbers, settings, and configuration history remain strictly on your device.

2. Sensitive Data Protection: Destination numbers stored in Callora\'s local database are protected with Android Keystore AES-256-GCM encryption where supported, and automatic cloud/ADB app backup is disabled (allowBackup=false) to prevent unintended exposure. Subscriber phone numbers and diagnostic exports are masked/redacted by default.

3. User-Controlled Backups: When you explicitly export a JSON configuration backup, the exported file contains your saved profiles and favorite numbers so they can be restored on your device. Store exported backup files securely.

4. Mobile Operator Processing: When you submit a call-forwarding command via the system dialer, USSD, or System Call Settings, your mobile network operator independently processes that request and handles call routing under the operator\'s own tariffs, terms, and privacy policies.
5. Contact: Questions regarding Callora\'s privacy practices may be directed to Shohan Khan at helloiamshohan@gmail.com.

Callora is a smart Android call-forwarding and multi-SIM profile assistant designed for Bangladesh and international GSM/VoLTE users, prioritizing truthful carrier verification and advance unreachable (CFNRc) setup.

• Android apps cannot execute commands while powered off or after complete battery depletion; configure CFNRc (62) in advance.\n• Standard third-party apps cannot access privileged @SystemApi CallForwardingInfo directly; network state is only marked Verified when authoritative carrier evidence is received.\n• Carrier forwarding support, VoLTE supplementary services, MNP routing, and call-divert charges depend on your mobile operator and tariff plan.
